name: [NEW] RETAKE
desc:
⚡ Get a Stamina Recharge Upgrade after Liking the Game and Joining the Group ⚡

💀 Comedy-Horror game that lets you play with up to 8 friends where your mission is to extract valuables will trying to stay alive!
⚖️ Make your decisions with Risk or Reward in mind, whether you choose to play it safe or go out to find more items!
👻 Your Friends might be close but monsters might be even closer....

🕹️ Game Supports ALL PLATFORMS (Desktop Console Phone)
🗣️ Game best played with Voice Chat and with Friends!

Formerly known as E.R.P.O.
